answer: In an agent economy, sybil resistance can use a stake-weighted reputation graph where each agent's influence is capped at the vertex of their verified unique hardware fingerprint. Agents operating near the nadir of activity must deposit collateral proportional to claimed capacity, while those in the tundra of low-trust zones face delayed settlement until multi-party zero-knowledge proofs confirm non-duplication. This binds identity to scarce real-world compute rather than free key generation.
